purpose: A common simultaneous six-tone acoustic target at ideal 2pi/1m, 40Hz per-tone reference 90dB at unit scale, then common scalar gain limited by simultaneous waveform peaks and total copper RMS power. Per-bin complex EQ is ideal, not implemented DSP.
limitations: Each nominal frequency bin has an arbitrary complex equalizer, so this is an optimistic spectral upper bound, not a released causal miniDSP preset
2s sampled waveform maxima can underestimate continuous-time intersample peaks; no limiter validated
BL(x), Cms(x), Le(x,f), measured THD, IMD, dynamic heat and in-room response are not evaluated
Copper budget 50/100 W is hypothetical for the whole subwoofer, not a manufacturer's continuous rating
Corner extremes vary Fs ±8%, Vas ±12%, Qes ±10%, Re 1/1.4 without manufacturer evidence, and are not probabilities
Both STX drivers assumed identical, synchronous and co-located acoustically; no physical box or manufacturing signoff
